user.title: Add a Galp Pluma cylinder
user.description: Choose a cylinder seen by your Bluetooth adapters or proxies.

gas_type.title: Gas type
gas_type.description: Choose the gas in this cylinder. Cosmetic only — it changes the icon.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Add a Galp Pluma cylinder
bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}?

abort.no_devices_found: No Pluma cylinders found nearby. Make sure a Bluetooth adapter or proxy is within range (the cylinder is only visible when awake).
abort.already_in_progress: Setup of this cylinder is already in progress.

data_description.scan_interval: Per cylinder. Examples: 60 = 1 hour, 1440 = 1 day, 10080 = 1 week, 43200 = 30 days. Use 0 to read manually only ("Refresh now" button). Each reading wakes the cylinder and uses its battery.

error.interval_too_short: The minimum interval is 5 minutes (or 0 for manual reading only).
